body:
Released in **[v0.26.2](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/releases/tag/v0.26.2)** through **[PR #129](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/pull/129)**, normally merged with checkpoint history preserved. Exact qualified runtime: [`e1cae49`](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/commit/e1cae49a9655a4a48a72c25f36bbd45db0273423).

Neistra now owns the viewer interface: native controls, information text, notifications, task/drag overlays and logo are omitted at composition. **Existing orientation axes remain**, as explicitly requested. Existing molecular rendering, picking, hover highlighting, annotations/measurements, surfaces, previews and app controls/feedback remain. Scene-loading feedback follows actual rendering and ignores obsolete operations. Qualification also fixed nested-root teardown ordering and projection jitter canceling double-click expansion. The complete Mol* license ships outside the viewer.

Both clean candidate and exact merged-master **20-command gates pass**: **1,262 Python (zero skips), 374 frontend, 12 supervisor/policy and 352 browser tests**, with **62 exactly unchanged layout exclusions**, zero final failures/flakes/automatic retries. All **595 source identities** and lossless log hashes verify. Actual tagged v0.26.0↔final 0.26.2 producer/readers pass both ways, including originals/coordinates, retained history, selections/scenes/surfaces, jobs and archive remapping. The published qualification ZIP was downloaded independently; its SHA-256, CRC and all internal file hashes verify. ZIP SHA-256: `6ae3fc4558626a4272c1afed402f6fd7170ce3fcb48964928420fab40d99cf76`. Earlier diagnostics/fail-first regressions remain retained. Review is local full-diff self-review; [Codex was requested](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/pull/129#issuecomment-6592134908), but no external result returned. Independent approval and strict reference-host timing are not claimed.

This is a stable patch correcting presentation/interaction reliability. All five authoritative sources declare 0.26.2, including the previously unreleased 0.26.1/PR #126 changes. No dependency upgrade, migration, API/job/plugin or scientific-model/schema change: Alembic 0014, project/viewer/archive 2 and normalized/selection/component 1 remain. Compatible rollback needs no schema downgrade/data stripping; retain complete managed-store backups. Archives retain current state; Undo history remains in the managed store.

Native screenshot/settings entry points deliberately disappear. Neistra-owned molecular image export is separately scoped in [#128](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/issues/128), because image content, dimensions/background, annotation and download behavior need their own design. Automatic native-feature parity is rejected as unnecessary scope; no new hover-information overlay, fullscreen/XR/illumination/animation panel, snapshot format, generic task mirror or renderer upgrade is introduced. [#97](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/issues/97), [#98](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/issues/98) and [#107](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/issues/107) remain independent. Existing annotation overlap and scientific limits remain. No essential approved outcome is deferred.

The [feature plan](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/blob/master/docs/plans/issue-96-application-owned-viewer.md) retains scope, decisions and detailed evidence. Publication records are being integrated through a documentation-only PR; final integration and branch-cleanup receipts will be added here.
